messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: rapid increase in pending pods for pool=spot-eu-central-gpu. pending=950 -> 2600 in 9m, evictions=37. SLO risk: 95p latency spike.

Maya (oncall): I'm seeing the alert. Pulling nodegroup and autoscaler logs now.

Ravi: Autoscaler shows repeated failures to create instances due to InsufficientInstanceCapacity and a simultaneous quota limit hit on GPU count. Cloud events show ephemeral reclaim waves in eu-central-1.

Jin: Preemptions ongoing: spot termination notices started 19:01:22 UTC and peaked at 19:05. Many pods became NotReady causing rapid scheduler backlog.

infra-bot: Autoscaler summary:
```
window: 10m
scale_attempts: 4
requested_vms: [12, 16, 24, 24]
successful: 0
errors: ["InsufficientInstanceCapacity","QuotaExceeded: GPUs"]
```

Maya (oncall): Current pending pods: 2400 (gen-svc and embedder-worker). HPA is maxed on CPU but cannot land pods.

Lena (support): Customer impact: increased request timeouts and 503s for model-family=redwood-embed-2. Enterprise customer C reported batch jobs failing. Tracking tickets: SUP-11300, SUP-11301.

Ravi: Quick mitigations I'm starting: 1) prioritize routing for latency-sensitive API keys to dedicated-hot-eu, 2) enable CPU-based fallback for low-priority embed requests, 3) temporarily lower per-tenant concurrency caps to reduce head-of-line blocking.

Maya (oncall): Initiating routing change for top 5 tenants. Using routing API with rate limit workaround (staggered single-tenant patches).

ops-automation: routing job status: tenant patch 1/5 succeeded, 2/5 queued due to API throttle. ETA for full push ~8m.

Jin: CloudSupport: opened ticket CS-98711 with cloud provider. They confirm regional shortage for RTX/A100 family and may take hours.

CloudSupport: Confirmed. Provider suggests cross-region placement but notes replication and latency constraints for some enterprise tenants. Quota increase submitted, no ETA.

Maya (oncall): Applying local runtime mitigations: reduce batch_window_ms from 12 -> 6, enable KV prefix caching for long-lived sessions, and drain non-critical worker pool.

infra-bot: Runtime patch applied to pool=spot-eu-central-gpu: batch_window_ms=6, kv_cache_mode=partial, draining_label=noncritical=true

Ravi: Also bringing up emergency reserve nodes in eu-central: command to warm up reserved-dedicated-1 (expected 10 nodes). Cloud reports 7 created, 3 pending due to quota.

Maya (oncall): After initial reserve nodes hit, pending fell 2600 -> 1200 over 5m. Throttling improved but still high.

Lena (support): Sent interim advisory to affected customers and opened priority support threads.

Ravi: Next step: throttle nonessential endpoints (evals, rerank) and reduce model size for best-effort traffic (gptx-large -> gptx-medium). Will apply rate limit patch now.

infra-bot: Nonessential routes throttled: applied rate limit 0.5r/s for /eval and /rerank prefixes. Observed drop in queue contribution from those routes ~42%.

CloudSupport: Update: provider attempting to move capacity from eu-west to eu-central but needs compatibility checks for GPU types. Cross-region fallback may take >30m.

Maya (oncall): Handoff plan: I'm handing to Ravi (night oncall) at 20:00 UTC. Ravi please ack and continue coordination with CloudSupport. Also assign postmortem owners.

Ravi: ack. I'll track metrics and escalate quota workstreams. Preparing incident report and timeline.

Jin: Note for postmortem: autoscaler did not have a graceful degrade path when instance creates repeatedly failed; it should trigger progressive fallback earlier (e.g., spill to dedicated or CPU fallback). Also preemption surge detection could trigger reserve-spin proactively.

Maya (oncall): Agree. Followups: increase emergency reserve size for spot pools, implement autoscaler quota-aware backoff and alternative fallback routing, and add a preempt surge monitor to automatically reserve cold capacity.

incident-bot: Incident logged: incident_id=INC-2026-0615-25. Severity: P1. Please update incident page: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0615-25

Lena (support): I'll continue customer comms and update tickets SUP-11300/SUP-11301 with latest mitigation steps.

Ravi: Final note: CloudSupport ticket CS-98711 link: https://cloudsupport.provider/tickets/CS-98711. Monitoring triage channel #incidents.
